description: Brick wall numbers: an integer k > 1, written as k = p_1 * p_2 * ... * p_r where p_1 <= p_2 <= ... <= p_r are primes, is a brick wall number if there exist integers h >= 2 and w >= 2 such that the prime factors p_i of k can be stacked up in h horizontal layers of bricks such that the sum of the p_i's in each layer is equal to w.
